column1: # Exact pinned client-go test evidence for Campaign 15 async completion core.

column8: Reverse injection order is translated on the one-shot completion path; BatchCommands transport callbacks remain external.
Invoke and schedule share silent first-wins terminal publication exactly once; BatchCommands transport callbacks remain external.
Immediate detached spawning and configured spawner delegation are translated without another Tokio runtime; the production BatchCommands pool adapter remains external.
The per-loop wait signal blocks and wakes when work is appended; production transport scheduling remains external.
One drive drains the initial task and the task it appends while running, preserving source execution order; production transport scheduling remains external.
A delayed second enqueue wakes the waiting driver and preserves source task order; production transport scheduling remains external.
Cancellation returns after the running task and preserves the next queued task for a later drive; transport cancellation remains external.
A waiting driver wakes on cancellation and returns the exact terminal identity; transport cancellation remains external.
The running driver owns the loop and a concurrent execute is rejected without corrupting queued state; production transport scheduling remains external.
